name: synergos-ui
description: Synergos UI — Multi-framework Web Components workspace

scripts.build: npm run build:angular && npm run build:react && npm run build:svelte && npm run build:vanilla
scripts.build:angular: cd platforms/angular && unset NX_WORKSPACE_ROOT_PATH && node_modules/.bin/nx run-many --target=build --projects=tag:scope:elements,tag:scope:experiences,tag:scope:cms-adapter --parallel=1 --outputStyle=static
scripts.test: npm run test:angular && npm run test:react && npm run test:svelte && npm run test:vanilla
scripts.test:angular: cd platforms/angular && unset NX_WORKSPACE_ROOT_PATH && node_modules/.bin/nx run-many --target=test
scripts.lint: npm run lint:angular && npm run lint:react && npm run lint:svelte && npm run lint:vanilla
scripts.lint:angular: cd platforms/angular && unset NX_WORKSPACE_ROOT_PATH && node_modules/.bin/nx run-many --target=lint
scripts.graph:angular: cd platforms/angular && unset NX_WORKSPACE_ROOT_PATH && node_modules/.bin/nx graph
scripts.setup: npm run setup:angular && npm run setup:react && npm run setup:svelte && npm run setup:vanilla
